verdict: Capital One earned $3.5B on $16.3B of revenue as the Discover business it bought in 2025 lifted interest and fee income — and excluding deal costs, EPS was $6.69 instead of $5.61.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: $16.3B in total net revenue, vs $15.4B a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: vs $4.83 a year ago; adjusted EPS was $6.69

kpis.label: Credit costs
kpis.note: $3.1B of net charge-offs, partly offset by a $225M loan reserve release

segments.name: Net interest income
segments.note: Interest earned on card balances, auto loans and other lending, minus the interest paid on deposits and borrowings — the bank's core engine, now including a full quarter of Discover.

segments.name: Noninterest income
segments.note: Card fees, interchange (the cut merchants pay when a card is used) and other fee income — lifted by the Discover card portfolio and its payment network.

opex.name: Operating expense
opex.note: Running the bank — people, technology and operations. It fell 2% from the second quarter.

opex.name: Marketing
opex.note: Card marketing and advertising — down 4% from the second quarter but up 14% from a year ago as the combined company promotes its cards.

follow100Note: Segment shares are rounded so the rows add to $100; the exact split is 78.85 / 21.16.

takeaways.title: The card engine earns a wide spread
takeaways.text: Net interest margin — what the bank earns on its loans minus what it pays for funds — rose 40 basis points from the second quarter to 8.41%. Period-end loans reached $462.5B, including $276.4B of credit card loans, now including Discover's portfolio.

takeaways.title: Deal costs hide the run-rate
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS was $6.69 versus $5.61 GAAP. The gap is deal items: $483M of acquisition amortization, $338M of Discover integration costs and $47M of Brex integration costs, all pre-tax. Management says the Discover integration is progressing well and synergy delivery is on track.

takeaways.title: Credit costs eased
takeaways.text: The provision for credit losses fell to $2.9B from $3.0B in the second quarter: $3.1B of loans were charged off as uncollectible, partly offset by releasing $225M of reserves set aside earlier. Deposits ended the quarter at $480.7B.

oneTimers: Adjusting items totaled $868M pre-tax: $483M of acquisition-related amortization, $338M of Discover integration expenses and $47M of Brex integration expenses (Brex, a payments company, was acquired on April 7, 2026). Excluding them, net income per share was $6.69 instead of $5.61.
footerNote: For a bank, the provision for credit losses (money set aside for loans that may not be repaid) plays the role of cost of revenue. Year-ago comparisons include Discover, whose merger with Capital One closed in 2025, so the card portfolio and network are much larger than they were before the deal.
